enchant_guidance.label: Should Restoration Shaman Healers Choose Aldor or Scryer for BiS in TBC Classic Phase 1?
enchant_guidance.text: Restoration Shamans favor choosing Aldor. The shoulder enchant, , from the Aldor is better than the Scryer alternative, . There aren't any notable BoP items from either vendor. Since many Restoration Shamans tend to have Leatherworking, there are various Leatherworking recipes from both factions, but nothing noteworthy enough to influence your decision.
